welcome.title: Welcome to RM Calendar
welcome.body: Your companion for the next chapter. Let's take a quick look around: Home for your goals, Calendar to log your days, People for those who matter most, and Settings to make it yours.

home.title: Home: your goals
home.body: Track weekly and monthly goals right from Home. Here's Personal Study, six weeks in.

goals.title: Choose your goals
goals.body: Select the goals you would like to track. Add, edit, or remove goals anytime from Home → Edit Goals.

calendar.title: Calendar: log your days
calendar.body: Enjoy the familiar feel of scheduling out and reporting on your days on the Calendar page. You can start with a ready-made schedule below, or build your own from scratch.
calendar.starterScheduleHint: Prayer, study, meals, exercise, and Sunday church, repeating.

eventTypes.title: Choose your event types
eventTypes.body: Select the types of events that you would like to use on the Calendar page.
eventTypes.footnote: Add, remove, or link event types to a goal anytime from Settings → Event Types.

people.title: People: those who matter most
people.body: Save contact info on the People page. There you can find people like John, a recent convert, and view his progress on the covenant path.

contacts.title: Bring in your contacts
contacts.body: Already have everyone in your phone? Import names, numbers, and addresses straight from your contacts instead of typing them one by one.
contacts.importHint: Pull names, numbers, and addresses in from your phone.
contacts.footnote: You can also add, edit, or remove people manually at any time.

settings.title: Settings: make it yours
settings.body: Choose your preferences now, or leave the defaults. Everything here and more can be personalized anytime from the Settings page.
settings.dailyReviewHint: A nightly nudge to report today's events.
settings.eventRemindersHint: A heads-up shortly before each event starts.

importContacts.title: Import Contacts
importContacts.introBody: Your phone will ask which contacts to share. Share as many or as few as you like, or none at all.
importContacts.accessDeniedBody: Allow access in Settings to import people from your phone. You'll still choose exactly who gets added, nothing happens automatically.
importContacts.couldntLoadBody: Something went wrong reading your contacts.
importContacts.optionalSharingHint: That's completely fine, sharing contacts is optional. Choose just the people you'd like to import, or skip this entirely.

unreportedEvents.title: Unreported Events
unreportedEvents.emptyHint: Events show up here once their start time has passed.

personTimeline.emptyHint: Events show up here once you add this person to one.

notifications.dailyReviewBody: It's time to report on today's events.

notificationToggles.dailyReviewBody: Enable notifications for RM Calendar in your device settings to use the daily review reminder.
notificationToggles.eventRemindersBody: Enable notifications for RM Calendar in your device settings to use event reminders.

settingsScreen.title: Settings
settingsScreen.signOutBody: Are you sure you want to sign out?
settingsScreen.deleteAccountBody: This will permanently delete your account and everything in it: people, events, goals, and settings. This cannot be undone.
settingsScreen.deleteAccountFinalBody: There is no way to recover your account or data once it's deleted.
settingsScreen.deleteAccountFailedBody: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.
settingsScreen.scriptureQuote: "But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only."
settingsScreen.signedOutLocalDataKeptBody_one: {{count}} change could not be synced, so this device's copy was left in place. Reconnect and sign in again to finish syncing.
settingsScreen.signedOutLocalDataKeptBody_other: {{count}} changes could not be synced, so this device's copy was left in place. Reconnect and sign in again to finish syncing.
settingsScreen.resetWeekBody: This will clear all goal counts and targets for the current week, and restore the built-in Goals (labels, icons, colors, links, targets) to their original values. Custom Goals will not be affected.
settingsScreen.resetGoalsBody: Built-in Goals (labels, icons, colors, links, period) will be restored to their original values. Custom Goals, and this week's and month's counts and targets, will not be affected. This cannot be undone.
settingsScreen.resetEventsBody: Built-in event types, colors, and durations will be restored to their original values. Custom event types will not be affected. This cannot be undone.
settingsScreen.resetQuickAddBody: This will restore the default quick-add types and icons. This cannot be undone.
